QuestInfo.name: [Halloween] Other Ether Gatherer
QuestInfo.0: Cassandra has figured out a way make her fortune-telling EVEN COOLER.\nGo see if you can help with that.
QuestInfo.1: Cassandra needs Other Ether for her divinations!\nHold on to the Flask of Death while you remain logged in for 30 minutes to fill it up.
QuestInfo.2: After you filled the flask with Other Ether for Cassandra, you received a Masked Gentleman Coin.\nYou can collect the coins and exchange them for great items from the Masked Gentleman.

0.0: You are going to have a... shoot, I can't tell! My crystal ball's acting all funky since the last update. I think it needs more Other Ether.

yes.0: Whew, thanks, I'm in the middle of a horror movie marathon right now and I do NOT want to get out of the mood, if you know what I mean.\nHere, hold on to this Flask of Death for, like, 30 minutes.

no.0: Seriously? Why is this MY problem all of a sudden? It's your future!

1.0: Just in time! Here's a coin for helping. The Masked Gentleman really likes these things.

yes.0: Hey, come back later too, okay? This marathon's going to take a LOT of Other Ether to get through. Probably a lot of cheesy puffs and diet soda too.

default.0: The Flask of Death needs 30 minutes to fill up! And don't log out! Gosh, when are you gonna listen to instructions?
